newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: SOCCER-CAR DEALER BUYS ALL ASIAN CUP MATCH TICKETS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAR DEALER BUYS ALL ASIAN CUP MATCH TICKETS.

text.p: A car dealing company in the United Arab Emirates has bought all the tickets for the semifinals and final of the Asian Cup to give them away to the public, a local newspaper reported on Tuesday.
Al-Ittihad daily said Al-Masood car dealers paid one million UAE dirhams ($280,000) for the tickets and would pay a further 100,000 dirhams ($28,000) in prizes during the matches.
Hosts the UAE have qualified for the semifinals where they will play Kuwait on Wednesday. Saudi Arabia face Iran in the second semifinal.
Al-Ittihad quoted the vice-president of the company, Tarek Masood, as saying that the tickets would be given away at Al-Masood's showrooms.
Attendances have been low at the Asian Cup and even matches involving the hosts have failed to fill Abu Dhabi's 60,000-seat stadium.
